name: users_audit_logs
problem: Sensitive actions need an immutable record of who did what, when.
glue: A write-path hook records actor (user id from auth), action, target, and timestamp into the audit_logs store; reads are admin-gated.
steps: Wrap sensitive service methods so they emit an audit event with the current user id.
audit_logs persists append-only rows (audit_mixin or a dedicated table).
Expose audit reads only behind admin_access.
